atlassian-mcp-api.$comment: Identifies requests to the Atlassian hosted MCP server (mcp.atlassian.com).

atlassian-mcp-session.$comment: Open and maintain an MCP session: initialize, list tools/prompts/resources, ping, and send notifications. Required for any MCP client to function; does not read or modify Atlassian content.

atlassian-mcp-read-all.$comment: Run any read-only Atlassian MCP tool: view and search Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management, Bitbucket, Assets, Loom, goals, projects, teams, focus areas, talent, capacity plans, code and the Teamwork Graph, plus the MCP session handshake.

atlassian-mcp-write-all.$comment: Run any Atlassian MCP tool that creates, changes or deletes something in Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management, Bitbucket, Loom, goals, projects, teams, focus areas, talent, capacity plans or the Teamwork Graph, plus the MCP session handshake.

atlassian-mcp-read-account.$comment: Identify the signed-in Atlassian user, list the Atlassian sites and apps they can access, and look up content formatting guidance. Needed before most other Atlassian tools can be used.

atlassian-mcp-read-tool-catalog.$comment: Browse the catalog of additional Atlassian tools that are not shown by default and run the read-only ones found there.

atlassian-mcp-write-tool-catalog.$comment: Run additional Atlassian catalog tools that create, change or permanently delete things in any Atlassian product.

atlassian-mcp-read-jira.$comment: View and search Jira work items, comments, worklogs, attachments, history, projects, boards, sprints, filters, dashboards, workflows, screens and users.

atlassian-mcp-write-jira.$comment: Create and edit Jira work items, change their status or sprint, add comments, worklogs, links, attachments and watchers, and manage versions, sprints and boards. Does not delete anything or change project settings.

atlassian-mcp-delete-jira.$comment: Permanently delete Jira work items, comments and attachments.

atlassian-mcp-manage-jira.$comment: Make administrative changes in Jira: create projects, change project settings, and add or reorder fields on screens.

atlassian-mcp-read-confluence.$comment: View and search Confluence pages, blog posts, live docs, whiteboards, databases and other content, including spaces, comments, versions, attachments, exports, tasks, templates, reactions and sharing settings.

atlassian-mcp-write-confluence.$comment: Create, edit, copy, move, archive and restore Confluence content and spaces; add comments, labels, reactions, attachments, stars and watches; complete tasks; change who can see content, including public links; and generate infographics and interactive visualizations.

atlassian-mcp-read-jsm.$comment: View and search Jira Service Management customer requests, request types and their fields, resolver plans, agent availability, and Operations alerts, on-call schedules and teams.

atlassian-mcp-write-jsm.$comment: Create and transition Jira Service Management requests, approve or decline approvals and resolver plans, set agent availability, and acknowledge, close or escalate Operations alerts.

atlassian-mcp-read-bitbucket.$comment: View Bitbucket workspaces, repositories, files, branches, commits, code insight reports, pull requests with their diffs, comments and tasks, pipelines with their logs, deployments and environments.

atlassian-mcp-write-bitbucket.$comment: Create branches and commits in Bitbucket, open, update, approve, request changes on and merge pull requests, add and resolve pull request comments and tasks, and run pipelines.

atlassian-mcp-read-teamwork-graph.$comment: Search across all Atlassian products and connected apps, and explore the Teamwork Graph: how people, work, documents and pull requests relate to each other, who works on what and with whom.

atlassian-mcp-write-teamwork-graph.$comment: Record a new relationship between two items in the Atlassian Teamwork Graph.

atlassian-mcp-read-code.$comment: Search and read source code in repositories connected to Atlassian: files, directory listings, symbol definitions and the code affected by a change.

atlassian-mcp-read-assets.$comment: View, query and search objects, object types and schemas in Jira Service Management Assets.

atlassian-mcp-read-loom.$comment: Browse Loom videos and folders, read video details and transcripts, and get video download links.

atlassian-mcp-write-loom.$comment: Upload and publish Loom videos, edit their titles, descriptions and visibility, share them, add comments and reactions, organize them into folders, and reprocess failed videos.

atlassian-mcp-read-goals.$comment: View and search Atlassian goals, their progress updates and goal types.

atlassian-mcp-write-goals.$comment: Create Atlassian goals and success measures, post progress updates, and connect goals to other work.

atlassian-mcp-read-projects.$comment: View and search Atlassian Home projects (cross-product project pages, not Jira projects) and their progress updates.

atlassian-mcp-write-projects.$comment: Create Atlassian Home projects (not Jira projects), post progress updates, and connect them to other work.

atlassian-mcp-read-teams.$comment: Search Atlassian teams and view their details and members.

atlassian-mcp-write-teams.$comment: Create Atlassian teams and update their details.

atlassian-mcp-read-focus-areas.$comment: View and search Atlassian focus areas and their type hierarchy.

atlassian-mcp-write-focus-areas.$comment: Create and update Atlassian focus areas, post status updates on them, and link focus areas together.

atlassian-mcp-read-talent.$comment: View and search positions, reporting lines and headcount metrics in Atlassian Talent.

atlassian-mcp-write-talent.$comment: Create skills, assign or decline skills for workers, and allocate positions to focus areas in Atlassian Talent.

atlassian-mcp-read-capacity-planning.$comment: View capacity plan allocations and search non-project work in Atlassian capacity planning.

atlassian-mcp-write-capacity-planning.$comment: Update capacity plan allocations and create or update non-project work in Atlassian capacity planning.
